06:02 AM EST, 12/17/2025 (MT Newswires) -- JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) has an average rating of overweight and mean price target of $332.32, according to analysts polled by FactSet.

(MT Newswires covers equity, commodity and economic research from major banks and research firms in North America, Asia and Europe. Research providers may contact us here: https://www.mtnewswires.com/contact-us)
</article>

<summary>
Keefe, Bruyette & Woods raised its price target on Goldman Sachs & Co. (JPM) to $363 from $354, maintaining its Outperform rating. This new target sits notably above the Street's average price target of $332.32 and reflects an overweight consensus rating among analysts polled by FactSet. The upward revision signals continued confidence from KBW in Goldman Sachs's earnings outlook and growth trajectory, positioning the bank favorably relative to peer expectations. Investors may view this as a bullish signal, though it's worth noting KBW's target remains an outlier compared to broader analyst sentiment, suggesting some divergence in valuation assumptions across the analyst community covering the stock.
</summary>

the summary misses (at most 3).
Step 3 - Score each criterion from 1 to 5:

faithfulness
  5 every claim supported | 4 minor imprecision with no investment impact | 3 one unsupported or distorted claim

ticker_focus  (does it tell a JPM analyst what matters, and represent how central JPM really is?)

  1 ignores JPM, or implies the article is about / important for JPM when it is not
coverage  (key investment-relevant facts: the event, key figures, attribution)
  5 all key facts | 3 misses some important facts | 1 misses the main point
conciseness
  5 no filler, easy to scan | 3 some redundancy or filler | 1 verbose or hard to parse
